## WHO IS ANTLER IN NIGERIA FOR?
We invest up to $250k, split into an initial ticket of $100k for 10% equity plus an additional pre-committed $150k to match your next VC-led funding round and terms.

#### **Individuals**  **‍**
Antler brings together a small group of ambitious individuals for an in-person Sandbox in Lagos where we turn an idea into a market-ready product and funded startup in just 8 weeks.

#### ‍    **Teams**  **‍**
**Start Date: September 14, 2026**

## The Investment
Antler’s first investment in a company is up to $250k, split into an initial $100k ticket for 10% equity, plus an additional pre-committed $150k to match your next VC-led investor round and terms.

In addition, we offer more than $850k in tech credits to all founders joining Antler (which goes up to $2 million in value once a founder becomes an Antler portfolio company), free office space in our founder community, and access to Antler’s global network of mentors, investors and fellow founders!

Antler was genuinely life-changing. Antler transformed how I think as a founder.

We came into Antler with a strong conviction of a problem, and the amazing team helped turn that into a real company in just 8 weeks. Antler truly lives up to its Further, Faster ethos.

The Antler team is truly in it with you.

What I love about Antler is when you have them on your cap table, you're not just getting $$$ but the most amazing community of founders & investors, as well as a war chest of resources to build your company with.

web.description:
# IFC Startup Catalyst
## Results (as of FY26)
- $111 millionInvested in Funds

## Startup Catalyst by Region
### Africa
IFC invested in Antler East Africa (“Antler EA”) in 2022. [Antler EA](https://www.antler.co/location/kenya) is a Kenya-based venture builder that invests primarily in pre-seed opportunities across East Africa.

IFC invested in Pamoja Ventures, LP (“P1 Ventures”) in 2024.  [P1 Ventures](https://www.p1.ventures/) is a Nigeria-based early-stage venture capital fund with a pan-Africa mandate, that invests in artificial intelligence, machine learning, e-commerce, fintech, healthtech, insurtech, and SaaS sectors.

IFC invested in Ventures Platform Fund IV (“Ventures Platform”) in 2022.  [Ventures Platform](https://www.venturesplatform.com/) is a Lagos-based seed fund that invests in tech and tech-enabled startups across Africa, with emphasis on Nigeria.

[Ventures Platform](https://www.venturesplatform.com/) Fund II is a Lagos-based seed fund that invests in technology startups across Africa and builds on IFC’s 2022 investment in the manager’s previous fund.
